data.gender_notes: Kibria is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Kibria refers to a noblewoman or lady of high status and dignity. The name is derived from the Arabic word 'kibriya' which means 'lady' or 'noblewoman'. The name Kibria carries the meaning “Lady, Noblewoman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kibria usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, noblewoman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of grace, dignity, and nobility in Islam.
data.etymology: Kibria belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady, Noblewoman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kibria total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
